snippet.title: Charlotte's Web: Wilbur and Friends (2006) [PC] longplay
snippet.description:
"Charlotte's Web: Wilbur and Friends" is an adventure game for PC, released in 2006 by Sega. The game is based on the movie and the book by E.B. White. It features nine mini-games where players can take on the roles of different characters from the movie, such as Wilbur (the pig), Templeton (the rat), and Charlotte (the spider).
Throughout the game, players need to complete various tasks and quests.
